title: 19-inch wall rack cabinet
description: A wall-mount 19-inch rack cabinet (EIA-310-D) of 6 to 15 U, 300 to 600 mm deep, every part bent from aluminium or steel sheet: two sides, a lid and a bottom pan with cable knock-outs, a back plate with wall-mount holes, front rails (and optionally rear rails) of L or C profile with square cage-nut holes or M6 holes on the EIA-310 pattern, and a vented door with hinge holes. Panels from the rack-panel Jig bolt onto its rails and fit between its sides. The flat pattern of each part, with its bend lines, is written by file.export with sheetMetal (see the README).
